title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Snooze Alarm 😂 Late for Work Again #shorts
desc:
ADHD snooze alarm: three alarms, one prayer, zero chance of being on time.

Work at 11. Alarm at 9:30. Woke up at 10:25. 😂 What's YOUR snooze record? 👇

Tip: put the alarm across the room so you have to stand up to stop it.

If this is you, you're not alone.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny
tags: how to wake up with adhd
what it's like to have adhd

beats.say: Here's how a normal person gets up for work. Alarm goes off. Get up. Go.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. Work at eleven. Alarm at nine thirty. Alexa, stop.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: She tells me the time. She tells me the weather. Cool. Alarm for nine forty five.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Nine forty five. Time. Weather. Same weather. Alarm for ten.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Ten o'clock. No new alarm. I'm thinking about getting up. Let me say my prayers first.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Amen. And I drift right back to sleep.
I jump up like the house is on fire. Shower. Teeth. Clothes. Go, go, go!
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: LIKE THE HOUSE IS ON FIRE

beats.say: Alexa, what time is it? Ten forty five. Well, I'm not making it on time. Might as well make my lunch.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Late anyway. Might as well make lunch.

beats.say: Ooh. If I take this meat out to thaw now, tomorrow me won't have to go through all this.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Thaw meat now = tomorrow me wins

beats.say: Wait. Am I really this hungry? I said I was gonna start eating better. Tonight, I eat light.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: New me. Eating light. Starting tonight.

beats.say: Then my brain says, you're already late. Might as well be late, full, and happy. Drive thru.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Already late. Might as well be full

beats.say: No. Be responsible. Set the alarm earlier. Which is exactly what I told myself yesterday.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: No drive thru. Healthy choices. And I think about that alarm the whole drive to work.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. Every snooze feels like a little rest, but an ADHD brain can't feel time slipping by. Put the alarm across the room, so you have to stand up to stop it.
beats.cap2: Tip: alarm across the room. No snooze.

beats.say: If this is you, you're not alone. What's your snooze record? Tell me in the comments.
beats.cap: If this is you, you're not alone.
